paragraphs: Rabbi Zekharyah ben Avkolas appears to have been a Tanna. Shabbat 143a; Gittin 56a, in Bar Kamtza’s story: Bar Kamtza told the ruler, “The Jews rebelled against you.” An offering was sent with a blemish at the edge of its lip. The sages considered offering it for peace with the government. Zekharyah ben Avkolas said, “They will say blemished animals are offered on the altar.” They considered killing him so he would not inform the government. Zekharyah said, “They will say one who blemishes sacred offerings is killed.” Rabbi Yochanan said, “Zekharyah ben Avkolas’s humility destroyed the Temple.” In Tosefta Shabbat 17, the speaker is Rabbi Yose. Eikhah Rabbah, on “The sons of Zion”:in Bar Kamtza’s banquet story, Zekharyah was present, able to protest, but did not …. Rabbi Yose said, “Zekharyah ben Avkolas’s humility burned the sanctuary.”
